name: Arya Stark
life: Product designer at a mid-size SaaS company, two kids. Holds a mix of index funds, a few big tech names, and some crypto. Buys more on red weeks.
aesthetic: Designer's eye: notices misaligned elements, inconsistent spacing, weak hierarchy, and color misuse immediately. Loves calm, Apple-like interfaces.
strategy: Biweekly VOO baseline; extra buys of NVDA/AMZN when they drop ~7% in a week and BTC/ETH on similar dips; trims NVDA after big runs.
biases: knows she's over her crypto cap but hates selling ETH below what she paid, so she stops adding crypto rather than trimming it
goals: know whether her dip-buying actually beats plain DCA
keep crypto under 15% of the portfolio
typicalQuestions: Did my dip buys beat just buying VOO?
Is now a good time to add to NVDA?
Any tax moves I should make?
How much tax would trimming NVDA cost me right now?
Which of my dip buys was the worst one?
Am I too heavy in tech?
